official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Enjin turns a written brief into a 3D model of a home or building that you can look around, change and take further.

For homeowners: describe the home you have or want, such as a 4-room HDB flat you are fitting out or a single-storey house on your lot, and see it in 3D before you talk to your architect, designer or contractor.

For architects, designers and consultants: test a massing, layout or form as real geometry, check its overall size and storey heights, and export it to Revit (.rvt) or Rhino (.3dm) for your own drawings and coordination.

In ChatGPT you can open your Enjin studies, see a model from eight views or turn it around in 3D, describe a change and have Enjin build it, and export the file.

Enjin works only with the studies in the Enjin account you connect, and asks before starting a build or a change.
